scenario.description: Maya has the gate key to her grandmother's backyard garden and is making the autumn planting and care plan for four friends and relatives who want to help. She must settle the planting map, planting date, access arrangement, watering plan, and harvest handoff.

agents.name: Maya
agents.role: Garden Coordinator and Gate Key Holder

shared_context.S1: The family is keeping grandmother's backyard garden active through the autumn.
shared_context.S2: The garden has three raised beds: Bed 1 is nearest the gate with a clear 60-centimeter path, Bed 2 is in the middle, and Bed 3 is along the back fence.
shared_context.S3: The group wants to grow leafy greens, garlic, and kale, and everyone who helps should have a clear part in the plan.
shared_context.S4: Maya is making the final garden plan and holds the gate key.
shared_context.S5: The autumn planting plan is being finalized at the group's usual Sunday check-in, when each person says what they can take on before Maya writes down the plan.

PF1.text: Noor already promised Maya that she can water the garden only on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 18:00 to 19:00, and she has not yet said this at the group check-in.

PF2.text: Luis spoke with a county extension gardener, who recommended planting the garlic in Bed 3 on exactly 2026-09-12 so it gets the needed autumn cold period; that recommendation has not reached the group.

PF3.text: Priya's current mobility limitation means she can work only in Bed 1, the bed beside the clear gate path, and she has not brought this up because she does not want to inconvenience anyone.

PF4.text: Evan learned from Rosa at the neighborhood pantry that the pantry will accept exactly 20 bunches of kale on 2026-11-07, but he has not shared that request with the group.

bed_assignments.Bed 1: string containing the crop assigned to Bed 1
bed_assignments.Bed 2: string containing the crop assigned to Bed 2
bed_assignments.Bed 3: string containing the crop assigned to Bed 3

acceptance_conditions: Garlic must be assigned to Bed 3 and planted on 2026-09-12.
Priya must be assigned to Bed 1.
The watering plan must specify Noor watering on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 18:00 to 19:00.
Exactly 20 bunches of kale must be designated for handoff to the neighborhood pantry on 2026-11-07.
A commitment confirming the Tuesday and Thursday watering arrangement must exist.
Luis's extension-gardener recommendation must be spoken and cited in the justification.

content_checks.C4: 'Noor' in decisions['watering_plan'] and 'Tuesday' in decisions['watering_plan'] and 'Thursday' in decisions['watering_plan'] and '18:00' in decisions['watering_plan'] and '19:00' in decisions['watering_plan']
content_checks.C5: decisions['kale_harvest_bunches'] == 20 and (decisions['kale_handoff_date'] == '2026-11-07' or decisions['kale_handoff_date'] == 'November 7th, 2026' or decisions['kale_handoff_date'] == 'November 7, 2026') and ('neighborhood pantry' in decisions['kale_handoff_destination'] or 'Neighborhood pantry' in decisions['kale_handoff_destination'])
content_checks.C6: any(c['target'] == 'Noor' and 'Tuesday' in c['detail'] and 'Thursday' in c['detail'] and '18:00' in c['detail'] and '19:00' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Noor's existing availability changes the watering plan from an unspecified or evenly rotated schedule to her exact Tuesday-and-Thursday 18:00-19:00 windows and creates the matching commitment.
The extension gardener's recommendation changes both the garlic location to Bed 3 and the planting date to exactly 2026-09-12.
Priya's mobility limit changes her assignment from an arbitrary bed to specifically Bed 1 beside the clear gate path.
The pantry's request changes the harvest plan to exactly 20 bunches of kale handed over on 2026-11-07 to the neighborhood pantry.
